prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pets", "Log in to restore your existing companions, cloud saves, and custom pet creations automatically.", "Sign In & Restore Existing Pets", "Create New Account"]
1: ["Testing Desktop Visibility", "Checking screen overlay permissions and graphic display so your pet renders smoothly on your desktop.", "Pet is Visible – Continue"]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try these 3 quick shortcuts right now to get familiar with your desktop companion.", "1. Double-click pet to open chat | 2. Right-click for options menu | 3. Minimize to system tray", "Test Controls & Enter Desktop"]
3: ["Creating Your Unique Desktop Pet...", "Our engine is rendering your pet's animations, behaviors, and desktop interactions.", "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to change its mood or activity!", "Rendering pet model and sprites..."]
4: ["Use well-lit photos facing forward for best 3D pet generation results.", "Recommended: Clear face view, high contrast, PNG or JPG format under 10MB."]
5: ["Feel free to use other apps! We will ping you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop."]
6: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion Choices", "Browse interactive animated companions and pick your favorite desktop buddy.", "Select Companion Character"]
7: ["Name & Personalize Your Companion", "Give your pet a unique name and pick their primary personality style.", "Pet Name", "Trait: Playful Explorer"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Sprite Canvas", "Estimated creation time: ~3 minutes. Your pet will launch automatically once ready."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet on screen now. Right-click the pet or use the system tray icon anytime to manage visibility, chat, and app settings.", "Start Interacting"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting photos of the user's face.
